# Config: Todo

> **Reader:** `TodoConfig` (`config/TodoConfig.qml`)
> **Schema:** `config/json/config.schema.json` → `properties.Todo` · category Modules · scope personal

Todo list: The one todo list every todo widget and module shows. The items themselves are kept in your data folder, not in the config.

Each setting: `path` · type = default · enum/range/unit; then title: description; annotations; `read:` the reader member(s) (exact unless marked) and `in:` the files that use them.


### `Todo`

- **`Todo.showCompleted`** · boolean = true
  - Show completed items: Under the open ones, the last finished first, until you clear them.
  - read: `TodoConfig.showCompleted` · in: `services/apps/TodoManager.qml`
